# ab-significance

> Pure-Python significance tests for prompt or model variants: Wilson and Newcombe intervals, two-proportion z, Welch t, seeded permutation tests. Python package `trysac-ab-significance`, import name `ab_significance`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests
